# SK ONE Tech Support (SKONE)

> Enterprise Managed IT Services, Cloud Infrastructure Migration, Custom Software Engineering & 24/7 SLA-Backed Tech Helpdesk.

## Overview
SK ONE Tech Support (SKONE) provides enterprise-grade IT infrastructure management, zero-trust cybersecurity, custom full-stack software development, and backup developer staffing solutions across India (Delhi NCR, Gurugram, Jaipur, Noida, Chandigarh, Neemrana) and international clients.

## Core Capabilities
- Managed IT Support: Cisco firewall routing, network architecture, enterprise workstation provisioning, server database maintenance, 24/7 SLA helpdesk.
- Bespoke Software Engineering: High-velocity React & Node.js web applications, REST API integrations, CRM/ERP platforms, mobile apps, database schema design.
- Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud (GCP) migrations, container orchestration with Kubernetes, Docker, and Supabase RLS architectures.
- Backup Developer Staffing: Pre-vetted contract software developers, emergency system administrators, and dedicated tech squad outsourcing with flexible 15-day scaling.

## Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Critical Incidents (P1): Response within 30 minutes, 24/7 escalation engineers.
- High Priority (P2): Response within 2 hours.
- General Support (P3): Same-day resolution.
- Uptime Commitment: 99.9% availability for managed cloud environments.

## Geographical Coverage
- Headquarters & Regional Hubs: Jaipur, Gurugram, Delhi NCR, Noida, Chandigarh, Neemrana.
- Global Operations: Remote cloud support and custom software delivery worldwide.
